entries.608789d7b37c1fc9: In the fiscal year ended December 2025, its pipeline at the clinical development stage almost doubled, from 7 at the end of 2024 to 13 at the end of 2025, and it also received milestone fees accompanying the progress of partnered programs. On the other hand, for the licensing-out of a myostatin inhibitor, it prioritized maximizing value through a partnership with the optimal partner and did not implement a contract in the current fiscal year, and timing differences also arose in other milestone fees and upfront payments from new partnerships, so revenue in the drug discovery and development business decreased significantly. The radiopharmaceutical business achieved steady revenue growth through the sale of new products and the addition of indications for existing products.
